title: AI Needs YOU: Quality Over Quantity Content #shorts
description:
AI can't create without human experience. Focus on 4 genuinely great pages answering real customer questions this year, not 366 pages of AI-generated decay. Quality content on a fast, readable website wins.
#AIContent #SEOStrategy #QualityContent #DigitalMarketing
